scenes: An empty metal chair standing on the tiled floor of a large indoor swimming pool emptied of water, close three-quarter view with surrounding patterned tiles.
A close low view of irregular dark stones with turquoise water rushing around them, no horizon.
A crowded worktable with tangled blue and coral threads, bits of ribbon and several wooden spools, overhead view.
Afternoon shadows of a hanging kitchen whisk and wire basket across a deep ochre interior plaster wall, the objects partly out of frame.
A red enamel bowl partly submerged in shallow water; ripples distort its visible lower half and the riverbed.
A small blue toy boat on the vast concrete floor of an empty indoor hall, distant overhead perspective, no people.
A partial view through a rain-streaked window, foreground amber curtain and window frame, fragments of a stationary parked bicycle outside.
Several mismatched everyday objects crowded on a shelf: a striped cup, folded glove, tin box and a pebble, close oblique framing.
Loose sheets of coral and cream laundry twisting in gusts above an enclosed courtyard, cropped architecture and moving folds.
A visibly mended chipped ceramic jug on a clutter-free cobalt kitchen tabletop, visible simple repair seam, irregular painted proportions.

additionalSet.style: Use case: stylized-concept. A single standalone square 1024x1024 image for an adult associative exercise. Expressive handmade acrylic/gouache painting with thick visible irregular palette-knife strokes, dry-brush texture, impasto, colorful broken brush marks, tactile imperfect edges, rich ochre/coral/cobalt/turquoise/cream accents. Match the painterly visual family of textured colorful everyday-scene paintings, but this new work is more ambiguous and fragmentary. No digital smoothness, no photorealism, no text, lettering, labels, symbols, characters, scenic landscape, water, paths, stairs, doors, mountains, growing plants, messages or prescribed emotion. NOT a collage or multiple panels. One coherent full-bleed composition, playful but adult, open to many readings. Do not reproduce any existing image.
scenes: Large cropped irregular overlapping translucent-looking angular planes, cobalt and apricot across a pale field, a small oval gap left open between them; uncertain whether paper, material, or spatial fragments. Airy sparse composition.
An almost full field of uneven curved bands and notched rounded segments, densely interlocking but with one displaced coral piece; cropped edges, flat shallow depth, no clearly identifiable object.
A folded rippling ridge crossing a square dark plum ground, painted burnt orange and pale mint; close view with rough broken edges, uncertain scale and material, one pronounced change of direction.

An off-center cluster of irregular hollow loops, ochre and ultramarine, surrounded by wide cream negative space; loops partly overlap, neither chain nor identifiable object, asymmetric painterly shadows.
Broad diagonal blocks with an irregular interruption, deep green against pink, one slender yellow fragment traversing the interruption; oblique compressed spatial composition, no literal doorway.

A shallow layered field of scattered elongated slivers and rounded marks, rust and turquoise on chalky lavender; some repeated, one much larger than the others, suspended ambiguous arrangement, no objects or writing.

A close-up of intersecting irregular ridges with pitted gaps, almost tactile, teal and pale peach on warm grey; partial contour extending outside frame, uncertain whether organic or fabricated, no recognizable thing.

Two loosely joined billowing forms against a heavy cobalt field, one coral and one ochre, a narrow strip of lighter space between them; brushed fragments imply motion without water or fabric depiction.
A loose staggered pattern of uneven small quadrilateral patches, warm yellow and muted blue, fading into a larger ochre zone with one unfilled shape; no recognizable grid object or text.

An oversized curved incomplete arc intersecting a low jagged mass, near-black violet with turquoise and coral highlights on pale apricot; deep spatial ambiguity, one tiny detached mark far from the mass, no identifiable scene.

reviewedReplacements.style: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE standalone square painting for an adult open-ended associative exercise, 1024x1024, not a collage. Match expressive colorful handmade paintings of everyday scenes: lively broken gouache/acrylic brush strokes, visibly rough paint texture, irregular painted contours, rich varied colors, playful adult visual language. More recognizable visual anchors than pure abstract art; do not dissolve everything into anonymous paint marks. Avoid smooth digital rendering, photorealism, text, labels, writing, logos, illustrative moral messages, prescribed emotion, motivational symbolism, paths, stairs, doors, mountain peaks, light-at-end-of-tunnel. No symbolism or interpretation. Show a tangible but open-ended scene with no explanation.

scenes.scene: Low eye-level view in a dense stand of reeds and tall grass, with a small patch of flattened grass visible between overlapping stems. Ochre seedheads, cobalt and green stems, coral touches, no path, water or scenic horizon. The cropped framing makes the scale uncertain. Natural material gives a recognizable anchor but no narrative.

A small dark animal seen only as hindquarters, curved back and a long tail disappearing behind a stack of irregular blue and ochre folded cushions in an ordinary room. The animal's species is uncertain, no face or human expression. Ground-level oblique composition, coral and cream floor, no message, no cute cartoon treatment.

Close oblique view beneath an old wooden table, showing mismatched chair legs and a single loose rounded wheel resting among them. Warm painted wood with teal/cobalt marks, apricot floor, uneven shadows, cropped framing with space extending sideways. A strange everyday arrangement, no people, no storyline. Not a chair standing alone like a prior image.

A cropped overhead view of an open circular sieve-like mesh holding several irregular pale fragments, with one small cobalt feather caught at its edge. Woven structure remains tangible; uncertain whether fragments are seeds, shells or scraps. Ochre and lavender ground, airy composition, not a cluttered worktable, no symbolic explanation.

A curved greenish translucent sheet draped over rough angular blocks; part of one block is visible beneath it and part concealed. Paint this as a material study with tangible edges and spatial depth, not abstract color planes. Ambiguous scale, coral/ochre block edges, turquoise highlights and indigo shadows; no identifiable product, no text.

Side view of a narrow shallow tray of dark soil containing an unexpectedly large curled striped leaf and several tiny pale mushrooms at unequal distances. Purple and ochre background, cropped tray edges, almost tabletop-scale but uncertain. Clearly organic details, no lush landscape, no stream, no growing-plant success symbolism.

A close sideways view of a pale woven net stretched irregularly between two worn red and blue metal supports, with a few folds sagging and an oval dark patch beyond. It could be a fragment of equipment or a boundary, no doorway or window, no horizon. Tangible mesh and supports with uncertain overall setting, colorful expressive painting.
